question: Why is nothing auspicious or inauspicious?
premises: Nothing would be auspicious or inauspicious.
If so, variegation power makes it clear.
The sattva self sees from sign only.
inference: Auspiciousness is not fixed; perception depends on variegation and the seer's quality.
plain_english: Nothing auspicious or inauspicious would be; if thus, from variegation power the sattva self clearly sees from sign only.
